overview: Newquay Holiday Park is a large Parkdean Resorts site about three miles outside Newquay town. It has caravans, lodges and safari-style glamping tents, with heated outdoor pools, a waterslide, high ropes, play areas, a bar and restaurant and an on-site shop. Several beaches, including Watergate Bay, are within a short drive rather than a walk.
surfTripFit: Better suited to family holidays with some surfing than a dedicated surf base, as a car is needed to reach the beaches.
